title: Phase B: adopt Papyrus notSection, notMedium and references groups; delete the hook filters and the 500 source cap
description:
Phase B. Adopt the engine's filters and groups and delete the hook workarounds. Blocked until Papyrus PPY-a9402d (notSection, notMedium, several sections; paged lists) and PPY-2d9715 (references groups by section with `per` and `data-total`, uncapped) are merged and released, and after Phase A is live.

1. Version bump: requirements-publication.txt `papyrus-newsroom[markus]==<release>` and package.json `@anthusai/papyrus` to the same release, in the same PR as the page changes (one deploy per site change; batch-site-bumps: MoM only).
2. tools/sync_section_pages.py + web/pages/reference-list.template.md:
   - stream on /videos/ and /findings/: add `notSection="<every label in web/sections.json joined by |>"` (the generator writes it; a section with no page stays in the stream);
   - every findings include (overview stream, section lists, the section front panel): `notMedium="video"`; the section front panel include becomes `count="<findingCards + 1>"` and FINDINGS_FETCHED_PAST_VIDEOS is deleted;
   - groups: replace the `count="500"` source include and the `mom-by-section` wrapper's data-source-count with `::include{kind="references" select="recent" bucket="week"@MEDIUM@ groups="section" per="7,6,6,3" section="<labels joined by |>"}` (plus `notMedium="video"` on Findings); delete GROUP_SOURCE_COUNT.
3. web/hooks.py: delete `_is_filed`, `_is_video`, `_keeps`, `_filtered_items`, the chunk-page filtering branch, the all-unfiled proof and the video filter in the findings panel. `_grouped_by_section` reads the engine's groups (`home-page-reference-group`, `data-section`, `data-index`, `data-total`) instead of regrouping tiles: rank = data-index, the More link shows when data-total > shown, and with a lead the rank-0 block is trimmed from 7 to 6 cards. The lead lift stays.
4. Specs: all Phase A scenarios stay green unchanged. Add to features/reference-lists.feature: case "all" plus a heavy case (1,000 filed and 10 unfiled): the stream's chunk files hold only unfiled References and none is empty; the Markdown twin of /findings/ lists no more than the lead, the blocks and the first stream page.
5. Rollout: one MoM release; verify /videos/, /findings/, two section lists; the engine run rewrites the stream chunk files once (their selection changed) and deletes those its cuts no longer make. Invalidation: none expected (the render purges what it writes); otherwise the list and the 25-path rule from the Phase A release task.

Acceptance: `rg -n "count=\"500\"|_is_filed|_filtered_items" web tools` finds nothing; `behave features/` and `pytest tests/` pass; the live pages match the Phase A behaviour.
